data.name: Musheera
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Musheera means 'the one who guides or helps'. It is derived from the verb shara'a, which means 'to open, to guide, or to show the way'. This name holds significant spiritual relevance in Islam as it reflects the guidance of Allah and the role of prophets and spiritual leaders in guiding believers.
